Add two new classes that dramatically simplify the handoff logic between the async worker thread and the main thread.

The contract between the two threads is that when `EplbState.pending_result` is set, the intermediate buffer is guaranteed to be fully populated. ## Purpose

This PR changes the `UniProcExecutor` to always use the loopback IP address in `_distributed_args()` instead of route-based IP auto-detection, since it only initializes a single local worker.

## Motivation

On Blackwell workstation / server parts (SM120 & SM121 — RTX PRO 6000, RTX 6000D, RTX 50-series, GB10) the GPUs are connected over PCIe with no NVLink.
